queue.text: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
queue.explanation:
Did you know that you have power within you that God will use to do exceedingly abundantly above what you pray for or pray about? This power is God's love that had been shed abroad our hearts by God's Holy Spirit. 
Would you allow this love to perfect your heart? It is the love of God. It is Christ in us. 
In that LOVE we live , move and have our being. May everything work for your favor.

queue.text: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”
queue.explanation: To Peter Jesus' word was command. He wanted Jesus to command him, "Come". That way he'd have no excuse, but to jump out of the boat and walk to Jesus, on water. If we'll allow Jesus' word to command us, no situation will conquer us.

queue.text: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”
queue.explanation: To Peter, Jesus word was a command. What is God's word to you? Shall He not command us?

queue.text: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”
queue.explanation: Only Peter responded to Jesus when He spoke during the storm. Jesus will speak in our storms, and if we'll hear, we'll jump from our boat and walk towards Him, on water.

queue.text: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
queue.explanation: Beloved of God, suffering as a Christian is normal; but it's time we ASSES our suffering. Are you suffering for Christ or as a murderer or evil doer or a meddler?
queue.author: Owner

queue.text: When the portions were served to them from Joseph’s table, Benjamin’s portion was five times larger than any of the others. So they feasted and drank freely with Joseph.
queue.explanation:
For once now, Joseph's brothers were happy for their brother Benjamin receiving five more shares than all of them! Seemed their hearts had undergone so much change. God had dealt with them.
Friend, just be a little patient, God is working on hearts of those who hated you for no reason. Amen
queue.author: Owner

queue.text: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.
queue.explanation: Those first four words blew my mind: BY FAITH WE UNDERSTAND. A question pops up: Do I understand faith. Faith in God is very dinamic. Faith in God will open doors that were meant to be permanently locked. Just strive to understand faith, and the power of it.
queue.author: Owner

queue.text: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met Him.
queue.explanation: When Jesus had finished talking with Martha, He didn't change position. Martha found her right there; same place. Beloved of God, Jesus will always treat us equally, love us equally - He's never a respector of persons. Would you trust His love and care today? He's ready to listen to you. You're so precious to Him, my friend.
queue.author: Owner

queue.text: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up. Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
queue.explanation: Beloved, do you feel the temptation of wanting to give up in doing good to others? Please don't give up. Keep doing good, a bumper harvest is coming your way!
queue.author: Owner

queue.text: And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
queue.explanation: God took stock of all He done, and saw that it was not only good; but very good. Friend let's learn that art of taking stock - that art of self-reflection and self-assessment. Am I doing good?
queue.author: Owner

queue.text: And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
queue.explanation: When done with creation, before taking rest, God took stock of all His works and He saw that He had done not only good, but very good. That same attitude should be in us - of reflection and self-assessment. How are we doing? Good? Very good? Or badly?
queue.author: Owner

queue.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
queue.explanation: The fruit of the Spirit does not happen spontaneously. Firstly,the seed is sowed then given time to grow to maturity. As we walk with Jesus, His Spirit carefully brings about the evidence of His fruit in us . It's not about us and our effort; it's about Him working in us for His good pleasure: Be fruitful and multiply.
queue.author: Owner

queue.text: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
queue.explanation: One way of pleasing the Lord is by being good to others through sharing with them the blessing that God has put in our hands. Please, don't be stingy and don't be tight.
queue.author: Owner
